title: Multi-year projection engine
story: As a user, I want a year-by-year projection so I can see trajectories.
description: Project receipts, spending and deficit year-by-year with lagged feedback and GDP growth.
acceptance_criteria: GDP compounds at the configured baseline growth rate each year
Feedback is zero during the lag, then ramps linearly to full effect
Each year reports receipts, spending, deficit and deficit % of GDP for years 0..N
